# Pillar RSK02: Excess time under water (RSK01 component)
Definition: Longest peak-to-recovery spell in months minus the world's over the same expanding window; an unrecovered drawdown counts to date. Weight 0 on its own: it enters X only through RSK01. Logged separately for REC03.
Source: yfinance .L and proxy monthly returns; ^NDX splice (verified). Better when: lower excess (one-sided). Informs: portfolio_mix.
